done_when: intent and non-goals are explicit
greenfield status and constraints are verified
success measures and principal risks are recorded

stages.condition: intent lacks testable requirements or multiple user workflows exist
done_when: requirements have stable identifiers
every requirement has observable acceptance criteria
material ambiguity is resolved or explicitly deferred

stages.condition: approved scope introduces or materially changes a user-facing web or mobile interface, workflow, navigation, design system, responsive behavior, or accessibility behavior
done_when: users flows navigation screen inventory and content hierarchy are explicit
visual direction tokens components edge states responsive behavior and accessibility are defined
visual acceptance criteria map screens states viewports fixtures and evidence targets
material source conflicts are resolved or explicitly blocking

stages.condition: new boundaries data contracts integrations or material NFRs exist
done_when: boundaries contracts data flow and failure modes are defined
security privacy cost and operability are addressed
tradeoffs and rejected alternatives are recorded
units are independently verifiable
every unit has one dominant risk and a done condition
dependencies critical path and requirement coverage are explicit
all approved units satisfy their done conditions
every unit has a recorded test strategy
units with business logic have passing unit tests or an explicit technical exception
targeted tests pass with actual evidence
changes remain within approved units
required build lint test and security checks pass
acceptance criteria trace to actual evidence
skipped checks failures and residual risks are explicit
when approved scope affects UI, required screen states and viewports have actual visual and accessibility evidence or are explicitly FAIL or BLOCKED

stages.condition: an external environment will be changed
done_when: target owner rollback and smoke tests are explicit
no release-blocking risk remains
production approval is separate and current

stages.condition: a deployed system needs ongoing ownership
done_when: health is measured against defined SLOs
alerts incidents and feedback have owners
learnings feed requirements evals or runbooks
